provenance: Original editorial structures written for this project; no third-party template vault imported.

templates.title: Decision before automation
templates.opening_instruction: Ask which decision remains human when a routine step is automated.
beats: Describe one routine handoff.
Separate the prepared output from the approval decision.
Name the reviewer and what they must check.
Explain who handles exceptions and where responsibility moves next.
templates.ending: Close with one ownership check.
templates.avoid: Do not imply the product enforces a rule unless that capability is documented.
templates.voice_adaptation: Use the client's supported vocabulary, rhythm and stance. Beats are reasoning steps, not mandatory paragraphs; shorten, reorder or abandon them when the idea or explicit brief requires it.

templates.title: Symptom-to-cause diagnostic
templates.opening_instruction: Describe an observable symptom the reader can check for themselves.
beats: Define the symptom without claiming it is universal.
Offer two plausible causes and a way to distinguish them.
Choose a small next check before prescribing a solution.
State what remains uncertain.
templates.ending: Invite the reader to inspect one real instance.
templates.avoid: Never diagnose a specific company's problem from an invented anecdote.
templates.voice_adaptation: Use the client's supported vocabulary, rhythm and stance. Beats are reasoning steps, not mandatory paragraphs; shorten, reorder or abandon them when the idea or explicit brief requires it.

templates.ending: Suggest trying the process on one low-risk example.

templates.title: Choice with two valid options

templates.ending: End with the constraint the reader should establish first.
